_comment: LinkedIn runs do NOT render body_template — li-writer composes each message per person. These fields give the writer the ANGLE only.
linkedin_cta: Ask for a short call to show how it would work on their side.
body_template:
Hi {salutation},

One person can send maybe 50 personal messages a day. So when you need to reach thousands of people, a launch, an offer, a list of leads, it either eats your team's month or it never happens.

Our system does it in a day across WhatsApp, LinkedIn and email, in Arabic or English. And it doesn't blast random lists. It only contacts qualified people who match the exact criteria you set, so every reply is someone worth your time.

Proof? I'm using this exact system to reach you right now. It picked you because you fit my criteria.

Hop on a quick call and I'll show you how it works on your side.

David
osgdev.com, IG @david.automates
